landing.title: Let AI build your perfect itinerary
landing.subtitle: Tell us your destination, days, and interests. TripPulse hands you a complete plan, map included, ready to live — not to keep editing.
landing.heroAlt: A road trip through red rock landscapes

highlights.title: AI that knows the destination
highlights.text: No "generic places". Real coordinates, local tips, and a full itinerary built in seconds, not hours of open tabs.

highlights.title: Everything on one map, the whole trip
highlights.text: Daily routes, saved stops, photos, and notes. Open the app and know exactly where to go.

highlights.title: Built for your agency
highlights.text: Give every client an experience with your brand, not a generic link. They live the trip, you stay on their radar.

plans.title: Choose how to start
plans.subtitle: Create your free account, no credit card needed

pitch.title: Give your clients an app, not a PDF
pitch.subtitle: Buy license packs, hand them out to your travelers, and let AI build their itinerary in seconds — with your agency as the one who made it possible.

valueProps.title: Your brand, not ours
valueProps.text: Your logo and color in the experience your client lives. TripPulse is the technology behind it, you're the one who looks good.

valueProps.title: Bulk licenses
valueProps.text: Generate dozens of access codes at once, with whatever quota you set: trips, AI generations, or both separately.

valueProps.title: They send themselves
valueProps.text: Each license goes out by email straight to your client, with their code ready to activate. You generate, we deliver.
